title: Sequential Validation, Repeated Tuning, and the Cost of Looking

assumptions.independent_look_formula: Each of K null tests is independent and has the same per-test false-positive probability.

finding: A test set becomes training information the moment its results influence another model decision.
qualification: The exact repeated-look formula assumes independent tests. Bonferroni provides a dependence-robust familywise bound when each test is individually valid at its adjusted level. These calculations do not alone quantify all machine-learning selection bias.
